dimension_grades.evidence: No wrong theories or false leads are described; the investigation is presented as a clean, linear four-step methodology with no missteps.
The post uses collective 'we' throughout and never attributes the bug or any misstep to the author personally; the framing is blameless and institutional.
No time durations are mentioned for any phase of the investigation; the reader has no sense of how long anything took or how much effort was wasted.
The tone is neutral and professional throughout with no self-deprecation, wryness, or humor about mistakes.
The root cause is revealed in the 'Root Cause' section immediately after 'The Problem,' before any investigation is described; the reader never experiences confusion.
The 'Investigation Methodology' section appears after the root cause and fix are already revealed, presented as a retrospective numbered list rather than an incremental narrative.
The root cause is stated in the third section with no preceding tension or ambiguity: 'The issue turned out to be an event listener leak.'
No emotional states (frustration, surprise, relief) are expressed anywhere in the post; the tone remains detached and procedural throughout.
Takeaways are generic principles like 'Always monitor your memory usage in production' and 'Heap snapshots are your best friend' rather than specific behavior changes the author now follows.
The first takeaway is literally 'Always monitor your memory usage in production. You can't fix what you can't see' — textbook generic advice presented without any self-awareness.

Takeaways are stated as universal principles without connecting back to specific moments in the narrative; e.g., 'Code reviews should pay special attention to resource cleanup' references no specific story event.
The takeaways use imperative/instructional framing ('Learn to use Chrome DevTools' memory profiling tools before you need them') that lectures the reader rather than treating them as a peer.
There are exactly two code snippets — the buggy code and the fixed code — which is a focused, minimal count.
The critical line in the first snippet has an inline comment: '// Bug: handler is never removed when this path executes'.
Both the problematic code and the fixed code are shown sequentially under 'Root Cause' and 'The Fix' sections.

Before the first snippet, the prose explains: 'Each incoming request registered a listener on a shared EventEmitter instance, but under a specific error-handling path, the listener was never removed.'
No concrete sensory or environmental details are provided — no time of day, no Slack messages, no dashboard descriptions; the closest is the generic mention of 'several weeks.'
Real tool names are used: Prometheus, Chrome DevTools, Express, Node.js 18.
All moments are summarized in retrospective narration (e.g., 'We set up Prometheus metrics,' 'We used Chrome DevTools') rather than dramatized as scenes with action.
